text:
marta_csm: Heads-up: Lumenate running partner showcase in Johannesburg next week. They need a short-lived regional egress allowlist + temporary rate bump to avoid throttling during the demo. Renewal status: at-risk -> medium (renewal 2026-05-12).

leo_infra: Thanks. Can you share exact source IP/CIDR, desired peak qps, and preferred window? Also confirm region (af-south-1?) and any headers to allow.

paul_lumenate: Correct region: af-south-1. Two prep CIDRs: 196.25.12.0/24 and 196.25.13.0/24. Peak ~750 rps but happy with a staged ramp. Window: 2026-04-05 10:00Z for ~36h. Need header allowed: X-Forwarded-Client.

sam_oncall: Staged ramp makes sense. Plan: 200rps -> 500rps -> 750rps over 20 minutes at start. We'll enable KV pre-warm and increased trace sampling for the demo window. Rollback if 5xx > 1.5% or P95 > 700ms for >10m.

leo_infra: Draft config below. Confirm and I'll queue the change.
```yaml
customer: lumenate
region: af-south-1
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 196.25.12.0/24
  - 196.25.13.0/24
ramp_schedule:
  - start: 0m
    qps: 200
  - start: 10m
    qps: 500
  - start: 20m
    qps: 750
duration: 36h
allowed_headers:
  - X-Forwarded-Client
prewarm_kv: true
trace_sampling: 20%
```

paul_lumenate: Confirmed. Please also whitelist Host header for the demo domain (demo.lumenate.ai).

leo_infra: Adding host header to allowed list and scheduling change. Applying as a scoped soft-bump on proxy pool "proxy-af-south-1-lumenate".

deploybot: deploybot: change queued -> applying to proxy-af-south-1-lumenate. allowlist 196.25.12.0/24,196.25.13.0/24 added; ramp schedule deployed; headers X-Forwarded-Client and Host permitted. Prewarm job scheduled. https://deploys.redwood.internal/changes/cc-1788 :rocket:

sam_oncall: I'll watch dashboards: errors, token latency, and cache hit-rate. If cache warmup underperforms we'll trigger an on-demand cache-fill script.

marta_csm: Great. I'll add this to the renewal playbook and run a 20-min enablement check with Lumenate today. Post-demo I'll collect feedback and note whether the uplift helped usage patterns and renewal sentiment.
